mapper.select: SELECT JD.JOB_NAME AS JOBNAME, JD.JOB_GROUP AS JOBGROUP, JD.JOB_CLASS_NAME AS JOBCLASSNAME, JD.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, JD.IS_DURABLE AS ISDURABLE, JD.JOB_DATA AS JOBDATA, TR.TRIGGER_NAME AS TRIGGERNAME, TR.TRIGGER_GROUP AS TRIGGERGROUP, TR.TRIGGER_STATE AS TRIGGERSTATE, TR.TRIGGER_TYPE AS TRIGGERTYPE, TR.START_TIME AS STARTTIME, TR.END_TIME AS ENDTIME, TR.NEXT_FIRE_TIME AS NEXTFIRETIME, TR.PREV_FIRE_TIME AS PREVFIRETIME, TR.MISFIRE_INSTR AS MISFIREINSTR, TR.PRIORITY AS PRIORITY, CT.CRON_EXPRESSION AS CRONEXPRESSION, CT.TIME_ZONE_ID AS TIMEZONEID, ST.REPEAT_COUNT AS REPEATCOUNT, ST.REPEAT_INTERVAL AS REPEATINTERVAL, ST.TIMES_TRIGGERED AS TIMESTRIGGERED FROM QRTZ_JOB_DETAILS JD LEFT JOIN QRTZ_TRIGGERS TR ON JD.JOB_NAME = TR.JOB_NAME AND JD.JOB_GROUP = TR.JOB_GROUP LEFT JOIN QRTZ_CRON_TRIGGERS CT ON TR.TRIGGER_NAME = CT.TRIGGER_NAME AND TR.TRIGGER_GROUP = CT.TRIGGER_GROUP LEFT JOIN QRTZ_SIMPLE_TRIGGERS ST ON TR.TRIGGER_NAME = ST.TRIGGER_NAME AND TR.TRIGGER_GROUP = ST.TRIGGER_GROUP ORDER BY JD.JOB_GROUP, JD.JOB_NAME
